Last updated: September 22, 2025 | GSTIN: 06ACWPB9701H1ZG | Effective from September 22, 2025
Fitness services reduced from 18% to 5% GST
5% GST rate without ITC for fitness services
Enhanced e-invoicing requirements for digital services

Service Categories and Current GST Rates (2025)

Fitness and wellness services are now taxed at 5% GST without Input Tax Credit (ITC) as per the latest government notifications effective September 22, 2025. Pure SaaS and technology services continue at 18% with ITC. Service classification determines the applicable rate - businesses must clearly categorize their services.
GST 2.0 Reforms: Fitness & Training Services (Effective September 22, 2025)
Fitness and wellness services GST reduced from 18% to 5% under GST 2.0 reforms. This rate is mandatory and applies without Input Tax Credit (ITC).
5% GST rate is mandatory for fitness services - cannot opt for 18% with ITC
Services at 5% GST do not allow claiming ITC on inputs like equipment, software, or operational expenses
Clear distinction required between fitness services (5%) and pure technology services (18%)
All invoices from September 22, 2025 must reflect new GST rates
Billing systems must be updated to handle different GST rates for different service categories
Lower GST enables more competitive pricing for fitness services
All B2B invoices above ₹500 reported to GST portal within 24 hours
Dynamic QR codes with enhanced security features on all invoices
All invoices digitally signed using government-approved certificates
Direct integration with GST Network for instant validation
Latest e-invoice schema compliance for all transactions
Automatic ITC credit matching with GSTN for faster refunds
System-generated invoices eliminate manual GST calculation errors
Enhanced TDS provisions for digital platform transactions
1% on payments exceeding ₹10,000 per transaction (reduced from previous ₹30,000 annually)
Applicable on cumulative payments exceeding ₹50,000 per month
No TDS exemption without valid PAN/Aadhaar linking
Form 16A issued within 15 days of quarter end
Available with valid certificates under Section 197
2% TDS on subscription fees exceeding ₹50,000 annually
Services to SEZ units are treated as exports and taxed at 0% GST with ITC benefits.
Valid SEZ certificate and Letter of Undertaking (LUT) required for zero-rating.
Enhanced GST Compliance and Record Keeping
Monthly returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B) filed within due dates
GSTR-9 and GSTR-9A filed by December 31st annually
GSTR-9C audit completed by chartered accountant for turnover above ₹5 crores
All records maintained digitally for 6 years with blockchain verification
Real-time data sync with GST Network for instant verification
